crossRefs.note: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.

translations.web: while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.
translations.bsb: before He made the land or fields, or any of the dust of the earth.
translations.kjv: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the highest part of the dust of the world.
translations.asv: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, Nor the beginning of the dust of the world.
